summary:
Directive 009 — STRATEX CORE Premium Command Interface (Presentation-layer only) — FULL PASS on all frontend acceptance criteria across desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) viewports.

DESKTOP: /ceo/login with Tony@Stratexdrone.com/1111 logs in successfully, token persisted, /nextgen renders NextGenShell with the new premium brand identity (nx-rail-brand = 'STRATX' + 'CORE' with metallic wordmark and orange X, hexagonal emblem visible). Home page (/nextgen) shows all mandated blocks: (a) nx-hero with full STRATEX CORE logo + tagline 'ONE PROPERTY. ONE RECORD. LIFETIME INTELLIGENCE.'; (b) 5-chip operational status strip (status-system=Operational, status-tenant=STRATEX Drone Inc., status-env=Preview, status-phase=1a, status-sync=HH:MM); (c) Primary CTA dynamic — nx-primary-create-first correctly shown because CEO has zero missions; (d) nx-kpis grid with 4 metrics (Properties/Missions/Stages Live/Passports); (e) 15-stage operational chain (all 15 nx-stage-N cells rendered); (f) nx-recent-empty correctly shown because no activity; (g) Desktop rail with 4 sections (COMMAND/INTELLIGENCE/DELIVERY/ORGANIZATION) and every rail item routes correctly with `active` class highlighted (verified nx-rail-missions→/nextgen/missions, nx-rail-passport→/nextgen/passport, nx-rail-awe-intelligence→/nextgen/awe, nx-rail-reports-binder→/nextgen/reports, nx-rail-habitat-sync→/nextgen/habitat, nx-rail-organization→/nextgen/org, nx-rail-audit-trail→/nextgen/audit — all 7/7 PASS with active state).

Missions page: nx-missions-search, nx-new-mission-btn (routes to /nextgen/missions/new — confirmed), all 6 filter chips (nx-missions-filter-all/-active/-evidence/-qa/-delivery/-completed), nx-missions-empty all present. Reports Binder: nx-reports-pdf-notice + nx-reports-property + 7 nx-report-template-* tiles all rendered as pill chips. AWE Intelligence: nx-awe-release-banner clearly labels 'INTERNAL DRAFT' (NOT CALIBRATED_GENERAL) ✓, all 4 rings (ring-air/ring-water/ring-energy/ring-composite) rendered when property data exists. Habitat Sync: nx-habitat-audience, nx-habitat-ttl, nx-habitat-issue-btn, nx-habitat-preview-link all present; clicking issue-btn with property selected produced live share URL, nx-habitat-copied confirmation banner appeared, active share links table populated with new HOMEOWNER row. Passport: nx-passport-header + 5 audience chips (internal/contractor/homeowner/adjuster/insurer) + 7 nx-report-template-* pill chips all rendered. Organization: tenant+operator cards render, nx-org-cross-ai attribution visible but subordinate.

MOBILE (browser.new_context viewport 390x844): shell renders, desktop rail hidden, nx-mobile-header visible, nx-bottom-nav visible with all 5 tabs (nx-tab-home/-missions/-passport/-reports/-more). Tapping nx-tab-more opens nx-more-sheet with class='nx-sheet open' as required; sheet contains nx-sheet-organization/-audit-trail/-habitat-sync/-properties/-mission-command/-property-passport/-awe-intelligence/-reports-binder/-signout — all present. Tap navigation to Passport/Missions from bottom nav works. NO horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390) on any of the 7 /nextgen routes tested. Bottom nav positioned flush with viewport bottom edge (y=777, height=67, hitting 844) with safe-area padding respected.

REGRESSION: /, /auth, /ceo/command, /reports/binder (legacy), /contractor, /operator, /pilot all load without JS errors (only pre-existing 404 asset fetches on `/` carried over from iter23/24, non-blocking). No new console errors introduced by Directive 009.

issues: React hydration warning `<span> cannot be a child of <option>` still fires — carried over from iter24, non-blocking. Source is a <select> option rendering a <span> child (likely in a property/mission dropdown).
Two 404 asset fetches on `/` legacy landing page (carried over from iter23) — non-blocking, do NOT affect any /nextgen route.

Rail brand text renders as 'STRATXCORE' with no visual separator between STRATX (wordmark) and CORE (subtitle) because they sit on adjacent lines without margin — visually functional but could benefit from a 2-3px gap. Not a blocker; the emblem + wordmark hierarchy is still clear.

action_items: OPTIONAL COSMETIC: add ~2-3px margin between STRATX wordmark line and CORE subtitle line inside .nx-rail-brand-text (currently renders as 'STRATXCORE' with no gap on desktop rail brand).

OPTIONAL (carried over from iter24): fix `<span> cannot be a child of <option>` hydration warning by moving the wrapper <span> out of the <option> render (likely PropertiesPage or MissionsPage select).
OPTIONAL: investigate the two 404 asset fetches on `/` legacy landing (pre-existing, unrelated to Directive 009).
critical_code_review_comments: NextGenShell.jsx uses `slug()` to derive data-testid values from label strings — this is robust for the current labels but any future rename (e.g., changing 'AWE Intelligence' → 'AWE') would silently break every automated test binding to `nx-rail-awe-intelligence`. Consider a static testid registry mapped 1:1 to route keys.

OverviewPage.jsx co-locates ~150 lines of CSS in a <StyleBlock/> component using template-literal <style>{}</style> — works but bypasses PostCSS and duplicates rules that could live in /nextgen/nextgen.css. Prefer moving to the design-token stylesheet for maintainability.

OverviewPage.jsx uses `awe.release_state === 'CALIBRATED_GENERAL' ? 'ok' : 'warn'` — this is correct for now but hard-codes a single positive state. If future releases add 'CALIBRATED_STRICT' or similar, the pill will incorrectly show 'warn'. Consider a `POSITIVE_RELEASE_STATES` set.

OverviewPage.jsx early-returns <ErrorState/> on any Promise.all rejection, which means a single failing endpoint (e.g. nxPropertyAwe with 0 properties) would black-hole the whole home page. Currently protected because nxPropertyAwe/nxPropertyTimeline are inside .catch(()=>{}) blocks, but nxOverview/nxHealth/nxMe/nxListProperties/nxListMissions are not — a single 500 on any of the 5 kills Home.
NextGenShell.jsx MoreSheet renders inline styles for the STRATX/CORE type (rgb hex + letter-spacing hardcoded) — should reuse .nx-rail-brand-text CSS for consistency with the rail.
MoreSheet nx-sheet-signout inline `style={{ color: 'var(--nx-critical)' }}` on the button but sets the same color on the inner icon — one place is sufficient (icon inherits currentColor).
The mobile back button uses `<ChevronRight style={{ transform: 'rotate(180deg)' }}/>` — Lucide ships a real `ChevronLeft` icon; using the rotated right chevron is a minor code-smell.

OverviewPage AWE hero (nx-awe-hero) only pulls data for `properties[0]` — the first-of-array property. This is fine for the demo but a multi-property tenant will surprise users because Home silently shows one property's AWE without any selector. Consider either (a) a property picker in the hero, or (b) a portfolio-composite computation.

Habitat page nx-habitat-preview-link exposes the raw JWT bearer token in a public href when logged in (`?_t=<access_token>`) — this is a security concern. The share URL should use the *habitat share token* (short-lived audience-scoped), NOT the user's JWT. Bearer-in-URL leaks into browser history, referer headers, and analytics logs. HIGH priority to review — likely intentional for preview but MUST be fixed before production.
Rail brand text renders 'STRATXCORE' with no vertical gap between wordmark and subtitle — small CSS fix (margin-top: 2px on .c) will resolve.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every data-testid in the review request located and functioning; every navigation link routes correctly; mobile shell/rail/bottom-nav/more-sheet all behave per spec

test_credentials: CEO Tony@Stratexdrone.com / 1111 (via /ceo/login) — token then persists across /nextgen navigation. Verified.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing tenant STRATEX Drone Inc. and its 1 pre-seeded property (01KXVSA7TX6FA6E7NWDNEZZX6N '1234 Test Command Ave, Denver CO'). Issued 1 habitat share link during test (visible in nx-habitat active share links row) — safe to leave, tenant-scoped and revocable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Directive 009 replaced the /nextgen presentation layer with a mission-control aesthetic. Access via /ceo/login (Tony@Stratexdrone.com/1111) — the CEO token in stratex_token localStorage transfers cleanly to /nextgen (Protected in App.js line 87 explicitly whitelists /nextgen for role=ceo). Mobile viewport MUST be set via browser.new_context(viewport={width:390,height:844}) BEFORE navigating — set_viewport_size() alone does not trigger the responsive breakpoints on this environment. All 15 stage cells are `nx-stage-1` through `nx-stage-15`, indexed by the operational chain stage number, not 0-based. The 7 report templates confirmed: executive_summary, homeowner_summary, insurance_adjuster, condition_snapshot, warranty_lookup, awe_deep_dive, hoa_summary. Habitat preview link currently embeds the *user's* JWT in ?_t= query — flagged as a security concern for future iterations (see critical_code_review). AWE release_state for the seed property is 'INTERNAL_DRAFT' (correctly labeled — not marketed as CALIBRATED_GENERAL).
rca of the issue: No blockers. Two pre-existing cosmetic issues carried over from iter24 (hydration <span> in <option>, 404 asset fetches on `/`) and one net-new minor visual (STRATX/CORE lines run together in rail brand — no vertical gap). One security observation on Habitat preview link embedding raw bearer JWT — non-blocking for preview but MUST be reviewed before production. All Directive 009 acceptance criteria met: (1) responsive shell works at 390 and 1440; (2) every rail item + bottom-nav tab routes to a real page with active state; (3) empty states render gracefully; (4) STRATEX CORE brand mark appears on rail brand, mobile header, and Home hero; (5) AWE release-state pill still visibly labels INTERNAL_DRAFT.
